title: Prove exact numerical peaks for BIT directory and ADD phases
body:
PR2801 leaves directory production and stream arithmetic outside its coefficient-lifetime allowance. This package proves their exact successful-call numerical peaks for unchanged PR2697 source, with all entry residents retained in the baseline:

- `directory.produce`: exactly `max(d²,6)` additional residue Words, hence 4,096 at dimension 64, and no additional index Words.
- `stream.add_pass`: at most six additional residues outside callbacks, including the returned coefficient. A restored fresh-result callback allowance `(R,I)` composes to `(max(R,6),I)` for the complete ADD.
- Conditional on the pinned PR2781/PR2801 premises, the inherited `(37672,34)` allowance above `Consumer.apply` entry therefore extends across each entire adapter ADD interval. Preceding `Layout.extents` and other caller phases remain excluded.

The written source proof covers the stated all-parameter successful-call domain. Exact finite execution checks 228 complete ADD cases, seven complete directories (including dimension 64), and literal ownership/content restoration. A separate math-storage-lifetimes AI specialist supplies an independent integer allocation-event model and 135 coefficient cases. Failure witnesses show why exception rollback and equal repeated coefficients are separate obligations.

Validation at `8abae69a53337dd3d0965db3470ab249b0216f22`: registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized CPython 3.14 replay, six external integrity/defect controls, selected-record binding check, and read-only Git-free export. Exact source files and typed receipts authenticate before execution; stale bytecode cannot replace them. Details and reproducible commands are in `research/selected-stream-directory-numerical-audit/VALIDATION.md`.

Scientific base `db3edc00`; submission refresh `28f54620` at 22:38 UTC on 2026-10-15 leaves relevant guidance, selected record and predecessor heads unchanged. Submission overlap covers 734 open PRs, 1,448 discussion records and 1,985 local records with complete pagination; metadata coverage is not a novelty certificate. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18960033).

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml for PR2697 runtime and Nick Petalas for PR2759/2770/2778/2781/2801 component results and handoff; retained source notices and Apache-2.0 license. New audit by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and a separate AI specialist. No human/formal-kernel review, full caller/physical-stock theorem, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. No selected record or frozen predecessor is changed.
